entry.title: III: Stylistic Delivery and Arrangement Techniques
entry.summary: Book III of Aristotle's Rhetoric covers style, word choice, and speech arrangement. Out of scope for this showcase.
entry.content:
Book III moves from argument to expression: word choice, metaphor, and sentence structure (style), then how to organize the parts of a speech (arrangement). Delivery gets a brief mention, with the reader pointed elsewhere in Aristotle’s work for the fuller treatment.

This showcase converts Book I only — Book III’s chapters are out of scope here. This page is a landing only, so the section stays navigable without dangling links.
